mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_article_like (user_id, article_id, created) VALUES (#{userId}, #{articleId}, #{created})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_article_like WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND article_id = #{articleId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_article_like WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND article_id = #{articleId}

SELECT al.*, u.username, u.email, a.title FROM t_article_like al LEFT JOIN t_user u ON al.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN t_article a ON al.article_id = a.id WHERE al.article_id = #{articleId} ORDER BY al.created DESC
